facts.fact: The ITU repository lists the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital' as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital' as 2020 - 2025.
The repository names ANINF as lead/owner of the Gabon Digital Development Strategy (SGDN) / 'Gabon-Digital'.
